buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work: 1- Advance intimation of shut down for overhauling job shall be given to Hitachi by PPCL and service engin eer shall be made available at site on the required date. 2- Complete overhauling of GCB Type HECS-100M as per O&M manual and OEM recommendations. 3- The vendor has to provide minimum 3 months Guarantee / Warranty period after completion of work of GCB overhauling. 4- After completing the overhauling, breaker shall be tested by OEM and same shall be taken into service after clearance from OEM service engineer. Duly signed test report will be submitted by OEM to PPCL 5- Testing equipment will be in scope of OEM (Hitachi Energy). Special Terms & Conditions: 1- The mentioned charges for normal hours of a day shift is applicable for 8 hours on working days. 2- Skilled and semi-skilled persons shall be provided by buyer / PPCL as per below Skilled: 6 (fitter) & Semi- skilled: 4 3- The skilled person must have adequate qualification. Skilled and semi-skilled persons placed at our disp osal shall follow the instructions given by HITACHI ENERGY technical supervisor 4- Normal Tools & tackles, Lifting Devices (Crane - 10-ton capacity), Scaffolding and consumables required for the job shall be provided by PPCL free of charge . 5- PPCL shall give at least 60 days advance notice for indenting the services of our personnel. 6- The above charges mentioned for normal hours of a day shift which are applicable for not more than 8 h ours spread over from 0900 to 1800 hrs. on working days. 7- Any work done outside normal working hours, weekly holidays (Sundays), public holidays etc. shall be c onsidered as overtime and same shall be charged accordingly. 8- The above charges mentioned for normal hours of a day shift which is applicable for not more than 8 ho urs spread over from 0900 to 1800hrs on working days. 9- The above charges will be levied for the total days of absence of the personnel from headquarters for ea ch completed 24. Hour’s duration. Any fraction of the day coming at the end will be charged as full day for the period beyond 12 hours and at half day rate for the period less than 12 hours but more than 6 hours. S uch Fag-end fractions of the day, when happen to be less than 6 Hours Period will be ignored. 10- In case of the Service personnel’s deputation is for a total period of less than 24 hours duration, the ch arges for one full day plus overtime, if any , shall be levied on the above basis. 11- Waiting time: The above charges will be levied for waiting time on account of site being not ready, non -availability of shut down and any other such reasons which are not attributed to HITACHI. If such waiting t ime prolongs beyond THREE DAYS, OEM reserve the right to withdraw their service personnel and the cost of to and fro travel etc. shall be borne by the PPCL. Re deputation shall be treated as a fresh visit and shall be governed by these terms and conditions. 12- Charging clearance of GCB shall be providing by service engg. of Hitachi after completion of overhauli ng work. Other Additional T&C: 1. The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity/duration or contract value up to 50 percent wi th the consent of the service provider as per site requirement. 2. The vendor has to quote the rates in given BOQ Price bid sheet for individual items. 3. The estimated rates are exclusive of GST/ Taxes as applicable. .
